def: a shoot (as if uttered or put forth), i.e. (generally) shrubbery

occurrences.text: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
